capabilities: Look up words while reading and save them to a vocabulary notebook
Review vocabulary with FSRS-scheduled flashcards and study statistics
Practice shadowing and dictation with subtitle-synced video notes
Generate structured subtitle notes from YouTube and Bilibili links
Analyze notes and pronunciation with AI models using your own API key
extras: Freemium: base features are free, advanced features (multi-language support, flashcard sync, AI batch card generation, export) require a one-time lifetime purchase. AI features need a user-supplied API key; dictionary lookups use free public APIs and no key. Claims zero telemetry and offline capability.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in tools for language learning, so learners must juggle separate apps for dictionary lookup, spaced repetition, and video listening practice.

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible AI provider (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Gemini, Kimi, GLM, Qwen, OpenRouter)
Premium version (one-time purchase) for advanced modules

summary: Immersive English-learning workspace with instant word lookup, FSRS flashcards, subtitle-synced video shadowing, dictation, and AI analysis.
